spells.name: Sacred Bull's Charge
spells.story: The black bull with the white blaze is carried in procession, and charges when crossed.

spells.name: Horned Viper
spells.story: Tiamat's horned viper rears up on its forelegs and strikes.

spells.name: Gate of the Sun
spells.story: The scorpion-man guards the mountain gate of the sun and will not let a mortal pass.

spells.name: Bull-Man's Charge
spells.story: A bull-man who holds up the gate of the sun lowers his head and charges.

spells.name: Dung-Ball Dawn
spells.story: The beetle rolls the sun up each dawn, and the dust it raises blinds the fighter.

spells.name: Hundred Legs
spells.story: The centipede of the tombs bites, and the bite creeps on long after.

spells.name: Sting of Serket
spells.story: The scorpion-goddess's servant lashes its tail at anyone who steps carelessly.

spells.name: Warden's Stare
spells.story: The winged bull-guardian of the palace gate looks at every visitor and does not blink.

spells.name: Storm-Demon's Roar
spells.story: The lion-headed storm-demon brings the gale down on the fighter.

spells.name: Wandering Dead
spells.story: A restless ghost of the desert follows the fighter, and the air chills.

spells.name: Empty Throne
spells.story: He tried the throne of Baal, found his feet too short for it, and fights from the floor.

spells.name: Fire in the Reeds
spells.story: The fire of the reed-huts leaps from stalk to stalk and across the sand.

spells.name: Moon-Traveller's Blade
spells.story: The moon-traveller walks the night with a knife for those who cross him.

spells.name: Panther's Claw
spells.story: The swift killer of snakes leaps, and her claws come down before the shadow does.

spells.name: Coil of Mehen
spells.story: The serpent who coils round the sun's boat in the night tightens its body round the fighter.

spells.name: Scaled Dragon's Bite
spells.story: The serpent-dragon on the walls of Babylon steps out of the brick and bites.

spells.name: Torch of the Gods
spells.story: The sun-goddess lights the way to the underworld and burns whoever steps in front.

spells.name: Birth-Guard Stomp
spells.story: The guardian of mothers rears on her hind legs and stamps at any threat.

spells.name: Cobra's Spit
spells.story: The cobra on the king's brow rears and spits, and the venom stings the eyes.

spells.name: Opener of Ways
spells.story: The wolf who opens the roads runs ahead, and the wind runs with him.

spells.name: Night-Stalker's Cling
spells.story: A night demon that clings to the sleeper like a cloak, and to the fighter in the dark.

spells.name: Hearth-Cat's Fury
spells.story: The cat of the household fire spits sparks when the home is threatened.

spells.name: Hound's Healing
spells.story: The healer-goddess comes with her hound, and the same hand that mends can strike.

spells.name: Plague of Fate
spells.story: The vizier of the underworld sends sixty diseases against the living.

spells.name: Binder's Serpent
spells.story: The serpent who ties the limbs together coils round the fighter's arm.

spells.name: Weaver's Arrows
spells.story: The old warrior-goddess weaves the world and shoots two arrows from the loom.

spells.name: Seven Gates
spells.story: The gatekeeper strips one garment at each of the seven gates, and he is hard to pass.

spells.name: Noon Judgement
spells.story: The sun sees every deed from the top of the sky, and judges the fighter in its light.

spells.name: Jaws of the Nile
spells.story: The lord of the river lies still as a log and then seizes whatever stands in the shallows.

spells.name: Pale Crescent
spells.story: The moon of the Canaanite sky sheds a pale light, and the cold edge of the crescent.

spells.name: Broken Wing of the South
spells.story: The sage who broke the wing of the south wind lets its remains loose on the fighter.

spells.name: Wading in Blood
spells.story: The warrior-goddess wades knee-deep in a battle, laughing, and the hall burns.

spells.name: Shepherd's Return
spells.story: The shepherd is dragged to the underworld for half the year and returns bitter.

spells.name: Eagle's Flight
spells.story: The shepherd-king rides an eagle up to the heavens, and the eagle's wings beat down.

spells.name: Turquoise Gaze
spells.story: The lady of the turquoise looks upon the fighter, and the look is heavy as stone.

spells.name: Clay on the Wheel
spells.story: The ram-headed potter shapes gods and mortals on his wheel, and the clay is heavy.

spells.name: Mountain Cave
spells.story: A lonely soldier left sick in a mountain cave rises, and the mountain rises with him.

spells.name: War-Falcon's Dive
spells.story: The falcon-headed god of war dives with a spear at any who march against the king.

spells.name: Dusk's Fall
spells.story: The god of evening brings down the dusk, and the light goes first.

spells.name: Flood Survivor
spells.story: The man who survived the flood at the end of the world greets the fighter with cold water.

spells.name: Heart Devoured
spells.story: The devourer waits by the scales, and any heart heavier than a feather is hers.

spells.name: Earth Laughs
spells.story: The earth-father laughs and the ground shakes in time with it.

spells.name: Star-Lion's Roar
spells.story: The star-goddess rides a lion and battle follows her at the heels.

spells.name: Secret Name
spells.story: She learned Ra's secret name, and the name now rings through the fighter.

spells.name: Seizer's Touch
spells.story: The lion-headed demoness seizes what she can and the touch burns like fever.

spells.name: Moonlit Cold
spells.story: The moon of Ur rises over the sand and the night turns cold.

spells.name: Mourner's Veil
spells.story: The lady of the house mourns beside the dead, and her veil is a shade.

spells.name: Mountain Mother
spells.story: The mother of the mountains brings the foothills to the fight.

spells.name: South Wind's Scour
spells.story: The king of the wind-demons blows from the south with a hot, dry sandstorm.

spells.name: Ibis's Reckoning
spells.story: The scribe of the gods tallies the fighter's strokes in the air, and wind scatters them.

spells.name: Stolen Tablets
spells.story: The great bird stole the Tablets of Destiny and beats the air with them in his claws.

spells.name: Sweet Waters Still
spells.story: The father of the gods lies still beneath the earth, and still water is cold.

spells.name: Tablet of Fate
spells.story: Tiamat's consort wears the Tablet of Destiny on his chest, and the chest is a shield.

spells.name: Seven Heads
spells.story: The coiling seven-headed serpent of the sea strikes with every head.

spells.name: Throat of Death
spells.story: The god of death opens a throat wide as the earth and the sky, and the dead go in.

spells.name: Whisper of Mummu
spells.story: He whispers evil counsel to Apsu, and the whisper runs on to the fighter.

spells.name: Star-Strewn Fall
spells.story: The sky arches over the earth and lowers herself, and the stars fall off her body.

spells.name: Breath of Shu
spells.story: The air himself holds the sky from the earth, and the breath behind him is a gale.

spells.name: Raging Lioness
spells.story: The lioness-goddess left Egypt in a rage and burns the desert on her way home.

spells.name: Sea's Fury
spells.story: The prince of the sea rises in a cold wave against the god of storm.

spells.name: Ferryman's Pole
spells.story: The ferryman of the dead poles the boat of the sun across, and strikes with the pole.

spells.name: Unbinding Word
spells.story: A fallen watcher who taught the unbinding of spells, he unpicks the fighter's guard.

spells.name: Bound in the Desert
spells.story: A fallen watcher of the old tales, bound in a pit in the desert, he rises with a handful of ash.

spells.name: Heaven's Bull
spells.story: Ishtar sent the Bull of Heaven against Uruk, and each snort opened a pit under the hero.

spells.name: Falling Star
spells.story: A fallen watcher of the old tales, a reader of the stars, he calls one down.

spells.name: Hunter's Mace
spells.story: The hero-god of the plough hurls his mace Sharur at the fighter.

spells.name: Thunder-Thrown
spells.story: A fallen watcher of the old tales, he brings the thunder to the fight.

spells.name: Oath on Hermon
spells.story: A fallen watcher from the old tales, he swore the oath on the mountain, and the oath burns him.

spells.name: Sand of Sokar
spells.story: The falcon-lord of the sand-covered road in the Duat guards the road below.

spells.name: Deep's Chill
spells.story: A fallen watcher of the old tales, he comes up from the deep with the chill of the abyss.

spells.name: Coil of Chaos
spells.story: Each night the sun's boat meets the great serpent, who coils round the dark.

spells.name: Stone Fever
spells.story: The demon of the hills and the stone, killed by Ninurta, brings the mountain down with a fever of rock.

spells.name: Storm-Rider
spells.story: The storm-god rides the clouds with a mace in each hand, thunder at his heels.

spells.name: Harvest-Lord's Flail
spells.story: The lord of grain brings the flail down on the threshing floor.

spells.name: Abzu's Cool Hand
spells.story: The god of the deep sweet water brings the cold of the deep.

spells.name: Winds of Enlil
spells.story: The lord of the air, with the Tablet at his waist, sends the flood-wind.

spells.name: Spoken Spell
spells.story: The god of magic, who is behind every word, speaks and the spell goes through the fighter.

spells.name: Coil under the World
spells.story: The dragon beneath the earth carried off the sky-queen, and the ground heaves.

spells.name: Vulture Wings
spells.story: The vulture-mother spreads her great wings and the wind beats down.

spells.name: Press of Seshemu
spells.story: The pharaoh's winepress-god crushes the heads of the damned and the wine runs red.

spells.name: Hidden Wind
spells.story: The hidden god comes as an unseen wind that fills the sails and the sand.

spells.name: Sky-Father's Throne
spells.story: The father of the gods sits on the highest heaven, and the heaven bears down.

spells.name: Winged Disc
spells.story: The god of Assyria flies in a winged disc above the army and looks down.

spells.name: Bull's Decree
spells.story: The old god on the mountain at the sources of the rivers speaks, and it is done.

spells.name: Nile Flood
spells.story: The god of the flood rises from the caves of the Nile and covers the fields.

spells.name: Falcon's Eye
spells.story: The falcon-god flies up with the sun in one eye and the moon in the other.

spells.name: Storm Net
spells.story: The champion of Babylon casts his net over Tiamat and sends the four winds against the fighter.

spells.name: Green King's Ruling
spells.story: The king who was cut apart and put together again sits on the throne of the dead.

spells.name: Noon Blaze
spells.story: The sun-god at midday opens his eye and the desert flares.

spells.name: Salt Mother
spells.story: The salt sea, mother of the gods, swells with serpents and storm.

spells.name: Hidden Veil
spells.story: The hidden lady of the primeval Ogdoad is unseen, and the wind speaks for her.

spells.name: Whole Sky
spells.story: The whole of the sky born of the first silt is a wind without edges.

spells.name: Self-Made Flame
spells.story: The self-created god on the first mound spat out the air and the moisture.

spells.name: First Mound
spells.story: The first mound, which rose from the waters, rises once more under the fighter.

spells.name: Endless Breath
spells.story: The infinite holds up the sky, and a wind blows for ever through him.

spells.name: Primeval Dark
spells.story: The darkness before the sun comes down on the field.

spells.name: Whole Earth
spells.story: The whole of the earth born of the first silt is a ground without end.

spells.name: Cow of the Flood
spells.story: The great flood, a cow, bears the sun up between her horns.

spells.name: Mother Sea
spells.story: The sea that gave birth to heaven and earth heaves up, cold and green.

spells.name: Waters of Nun
spells.story: The dark, boundless water before creation stands behind the fighter.
